title: Bot Kuning
genre: Malay 1960s Shadows-style guitar-instrumental pop with sung vocals (twangy lead guitar, spring reverb, upbeat)
subject: Rahim scrapes his old hull and paints it bright yellow among sixty identical blue boats so his wife can pick his boat out from the kitchen window when he comes home
caption: Malay 1960s Shadows-style guitar-instrumental pop with sung vocals, upbeat sub-style with melodic guitar answer lines between verses. Twangy lead electric guitar with heavy spring reverb and tremolo-arm bends, clean rhythm guitar with bright chiming strums, round bass guitar walking in eighths, tight live drum kit with crisp snare on beats two and four. Spring reverb, tube amp warmth, dry tight drums. Male tenor lead, mid register, light cheerful delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, A major. Bright, playful, upbeat mood. No synth, no drum machine, no autotune, no rap, no trap hi-hats, no distorted metal guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - twangy lead guitar]

[Verse 1]
Enam puluh bot biru atas pasir
Semua sama, semua pudar
Rahim kikis lambung dengan pisau lama
Dua tin cat kuning, tangan penuh cat

[Pre-Chorus]
Yah menjenguk, tanya abang buat apa
Biar kau nampak dari dapur

[Chorus]
Bot kuning, bot kuning
Dari tingkap dapur kau boleh cari
Bot kuning, bot kuning
Petang nanti kau tahu yang mana

[Verse 2]
Lebai tolong angkat tin cat
Budak-budak jerit, bot pisang goreng
Rahim tak kisah, berus naik turun
Lambung kiri siap, lambung kanan pula

[Pre-Chorus]
Matahari panas, cat pun cepat kering
Dia tulis nama Yah, huruf hitam besar

[Chorus]
Bot kuning, bot kuning
Dari tingkap dapur kau boleh cari
Bot kuning, bot kuning
Bila aku balik, kau dah berdiri

[Bridge - lead guitar solo]

[Chorus]
Bot kuning, bot kuning
Kelabu pun kau nampak dari jauh
Bot kuning, bot kuning
Aku pulang ke tempat yang kau tunjuk

[Outro - lead guitar fades]
Bot kuning, bot kuning
Yah di tingkap, aku di haluan
